description.value: Tiny free camp on the Johnstone Strait shore near the Robson Bight Ecological Reserve, reached by roughly 32 km of forest service road from Highway 19; the setting is remarkable for orca and marine mammal watching, but the long FSR haul makes it a serious undertaking for a loaded touring bike.

address.value: Naka Creek Rd, Garden Bay, BC V0N 1A0, Canada

raw_osm.description: Developed site. Gravel / pebble beach, exposed. Water at tap or water from culvert above the rec site. Road access could be rough. Parking. View. Logging camp nearby but all buildings have been removed from the site. Whale rubbing beach. Boat launch.
raw_osm.name: Naka Creek (BCMT)

wow_evidence: setting is remarkable for orca and marine mammal watching; long FSR haul makes it a serious undertaking for a loaded touring bike
